create.name: Michael Drake
create.bio:
Michael Drake is an American shamanic drummer, author and publisher. He grew up in a Southern Baptist church, where a moment of rapture at a revival meeting as a young man set him searching, and over the following decades he read widely in Christianity, Taoism, Buddhism and modern science before shamanic drumming became the centre of his practice. He went on to study with Native elders and shamans, and in 1991 he set up Talking Drum Publications to publish teaching books and drumming recordings.

His approach treats the drum as a vehicle for trance: a steady beat, usually between three and seven strikes a second, that helps a person journey inward, meet helping spirits and ask for guidance. He has led drum circles and experiential workshops across the United States for some thirty years. His books include The Shamanic Drum, Shamanic Drumming: Calling the Spirits, a guide to running drumming circles and the memoir Riding Spirit Horse, and since 2001 he has written about shamanism, ritual and the seasons on his website and blog. His drumming tracks for journeying are also on Insight Timer.

books.title: The Shamanic Drum: A Guide to Sacred Drumming
books.author: Michael Drake
books.description: His first practical handbook on drumming as a spiritual practice. Short lessons and exercises cover making sacred space, journeying with the drum, power animals and starting a drum circle, and no musical background is assumed.

books.title: Shamanic Drumming: Calling the Spirits
books.author: Michael Drake
books.description: A follow-up to The Shamanic Drum, written for readers who feel drawn to shamanic work. He tells the story of his own calling and gives further exercises for working with helping spirits through the drum and within a community.

free_resources.title: Shamanic Journeying guide
free_resources.description: A free introduction on his site to the shamanic journey: what it is, why people undertake one and how a steady drumbeat is used to enter and come back from the trance.

free_resources.title: Shamanic Drumming Circles Guide
free_resources.description: Free step-by-step guidance on starting or deepening a shamanic drumming circle, from how a circle is held to what it offers its members, with a list of circles around the world.

free_resources.title: Michael Drake on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His free shamanic drumming tracks on Insight Timer, recorded for journeying and meditation.
